title: Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVI OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(SECOND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE
XLVI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the
Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 6th November, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑84/Law/95,
dated 6‑11‑2001.‑‑--The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas, it is
expedient further to amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act,
1998, in the manner hereinafter appearing:
And whereas the
Governor of Balochistan is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore,
.in pursuance of Article 4 of the Provisional Constitution (Amendment) Order,
1999 (Chief Executive's Order No.9 of 1999) and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the Governor of Balochistan is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:‑
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This
.Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority (Second
Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 6th November, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑84/Law/95,
dated 6‑11‑2001.‑‑--The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment
of section 2 of Act I of 1998.‑‑‑In
the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998, hereinafter referred
to as the said Act, for clause (fa) of section 2, the following shall be
substituted:‑
(fa)
"Director General" means the Director General of the Authority;
